create_WerCalculator: create a WerCalculator instance with a tokenizer and optional output streams for reference and hypothesis text
compute_wer: compute word error rate by decoding CTC logits and comparing predictions against ground truth transcriptions
from_context: build a WerCalculator from a RecipeContext to automatically set up transcription output files for each DP rank
generate_hypotheses: generate hypothesis sequences from model logits using greedy argmax decoding with blank label removal
process_metric_values: process and update WER and UER metric values in a metric bag during model evaluation
